title: Trace/span field-name variant order controls logsLink query priority
answers: Why do trace_id-based log queries come before traceID ones in Explore?
How is the order of generated Loki log queries for a trace determined?
Changing the order of trace_id/traceID field variants breaks tests
Where is the list of possible trace/span field name casings for logs correlation?
body:
Symptom: Explore 'logs for this span' queries tried less-common field casings (traceID) before the much more common trace_id, requiring extra queries/time to find a match.
Root cause: TRACE_SPAN_ID_FIELD_VARIANTS in public/app/features/explore/TraceView/components/logsLink.ts lists field-name pairs in the order they are probed/queried; order directly drives query generation order and refId suffixes (t2l:default:<trace field>).
Fix pattern: Reorder the variants array by real-world match frequency (most common first) rather than alphabetically/arbitrarily; no logic change needed, only array order.
Constraints: This array is duplicated (not imported) in public/app/features/explore/TraceView/components/logsLink.test.ts and public/app/features/explore/TraceView/createSpanLink.test.ts for test fixtures — any reorder or addition here must be mirrored there, and test assertions keyed on queries[0]/refId index must be updated to match the new order.
says: Clicking logs for this span in trace view takes too long to load.
Correlated log queries should search standard trace identifier fields before trying alternative casings.
Navigating from a trace span to related logs triggers multiple slow fallback queries.
Speed up log retrieval when jumping to logs from an open trace waterfall.
Explore screen delays displaying logs for the selected span due to query ordering.
search: The TRACE_SPAN_ID_FIELD_VARIANTS array order in public/app/features/explore/TraceView/components/logsLink.ts directly controls the sequence of field-name queries and refId suffix generation in logs-link queries. Reordering variants by real-world match frequency (most common field names first) reduces unnecessary queries—for example, probing trace_id before the less-common traceID improves Explore performance. This array is duplicated (not imported) in test fixtures at public/app/features/explore/TraceView/components/logsLink.test.ts and public/app/features/explore/TraceView/createSpanLink.test.ts; any reorder or addition must be mirrored in both test files and all assertions keyed on query index or refId must be updated to reflect the new order.
